messages:
Ivy S: Flagging PR #9345 — the pricing examples section mixes list-rate math with post-contract discounts and an older notion of embedding units. Could be misleading.
Tom H: Paste the snippet? Want to be sure we're talking about the same block.
Ivy S: Current doc snippet: 
```
Example request: generate 1024 tokens + 3 embeddings
Generation: 1024 * $0.00002 = $0.02048
Embeddings: 3 * $0.00030 = $0.00090
Total = $0.02138
```
This assumes everything is billed at list and ignores reserved-capacity reductions and token rounding rules.
Rina (docs): Thanks. Two fixes: 1) show list vs post-discount numbers, 2) add small note that Console billing panels separate meter streams (generation vs embeddings) and that users on Dedicated may see generation discounted.
Omar B: Also worth calling out that embeddings have a different tiering scheme (per-unit buckets) and our backend sometimes aggregates small embedding calls into a single billing event for the billing window. So examples should be high-level and link to the metering glossary.
Ivy S: Proposed replacement worked example (concise): 
```
Illustrative example (not a quote):
Request: generate 1024 tokens + 3 embeddings
List: generation = 1024 * $0.00002 = $0.02048
List: embeddings = 3 * $0.00030 = $0.00090
List subtotal = $0.02138
Reserved discount (generation only, example 12%): generation discounted = $0.02048 * 0.88 = $0.0180224
Total after discount = $0.0180224 + $0.00090 = $0.0189224 (~$0.01892)
Note: tokens are rounded per-request; embedding billing may be aggregated by billing window. See metering glossary for definitions of `token` and `embedding unit`.
```
Tom H: Good. Can we add a tiny SDK snippet (Go) so engs can cross-check telemetry -> meters? And show how the Console panels map to meter names.
Rina (docs): Yes, add Go snippet and a 3-line bullet matrix: Hosted (no reserved discounts); Dedicated (reserved generation often applies); Private (contract dependent). Also include a Console screenshot callout.
Ivy S: Go snippet suggestion: 
```go
// go example (pseudo)
resp, _ := client.Responses.Create(ctx, ResponsesCreateParams{
  Model: "rw-instruct-1",
  Input: "Explain the idea",
})
// separate embeddings call
emb, _ := client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, EmbeddingsCreateParams{Model: "rw-embed-1", Inputs: []string{"a","b","c"}})
// Billing emits: generation.tokens -> 1024, embeddings.units -> 3
```
Omar B: One more: add a short line about burst credits / rate-slab behavior (e.g., per-minute smoothing) so readers with high throughput know why per-request and dashboard numbers can diverge. Keep it one sentence.
Rina (docs): I'll reword the heading to "Mixed-workload billing (worked example)" and add the small matrix + screenshot pointer + link to metering glossary. Ivy, can you drop the examples into PR #9345?
Ivy S: Pushed commit with the changed numbers, Go snippet, and the conservative 12% illustrative discount. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9345 :eyes:
CI-Bot: docs/build -> succeeded (https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/9345) :white_check_mark:
Tom H: Quick sanity: maybe use 10% instead of 12% to be conservative? Up to docs.
Ivy S: Switched to 10% and labeled it clearly as an example. Updated PR link.
Rina (docs): Reviewing now; should be a fast merge if CI stays green. Thanks all :thumbsup:
